note: spring5-security-batch: Spring 7 removed suffix-pattern / trailing-slash / path-extension matching (PathMatchConfigurer / ContentNegotiationConfigurer) — L2 `compile|cannot_find_symbol|setUseSuffixPatternMatch` (59bc06d915) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|favorPathExtension` (9f5f98fda8)
response:
<analysis>Spring Framework 7 removed suffix pattern matching, trailing-slash matching and path-extension content negotiation (setUseSuffixPatternMatch, setUseTrailingSlashMatch, favorPathExtension …). Their false / true settings have no equivalent switch any more: the script removes those calls from the configurer chains, keeps the remaining calls (favorParameter) and leaves a MIGRATION-TODO where a statement disappears completely (trailing-slash URLs need a UrlHandlerFilter now).</analysis>
<script>
import re

REMOVED = re.compile(r"\.(?:setUseSuffixPatternMatch|setUseTrailingSlashMatch|setUseRegisteredSuffixPatternMatch|"
                     r"favorPathExtension|ignoreUnknownPathExtensions)\([^()]*\)")
TODO = ("// MIGRATION-TODO: Spring 7 removed suffix-pattern / trailing-slash / path-extension matching; "
        "verify URLs ending in '/' or an extension (UrlHandlerFilter for trailing slashes)")

def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen


def fix(p):
    for path in error_files(p):
        rows = p.read(path).split("\n")
        out, changed = [], 0
        for row in rows:
            new = REMOVED.sub("", row)
            if new == row:
                out.append(row)
                continue
            changed += 1
            indent = row[:len(row) - len(row.lstrip())]
            if re.fullmatch(r"\s*\w+\s*;\s*", new):
                out.append(indent + TODO)
            else:
                out.append(new)
        if changed:
            p.write(path, "\n".join(out))
        p.log(f"{path}: removed Spring 7 matching options on {changed} line(s)")
</script>
